GET /orders?page=N
    Authenticated. Lists orders, 50 per page; N starts at 1.

    Each order has: id, customer_id, status, placed_at, amount_cents.
    status is one of: placed, shipped, cancelled, returned.
    placed_at is an ISO 8601 timestamp. amount_cents is an integer number of cents.

GET /customers/{id}
    Authenticated. Returns {"id", "name", "region", "tier", "discount_pct"}; 404 if the id is unknown.

assert sorted(x.name for x in p.parent.iterdir())==['result.json']
print('Final file validation passed; result.json is the only workspace deliverable.')
PY"

Wrote and validated [result.json](/workspace/result.json).

Total: **9,329,707 cents** across **407 qualifying orders**.

Skipped 20 duplicate listings. One shipped order dated February 28 locally fell on March 1 in UTC, so it correctly counted. Regional totals reconcile, and per-order half-up rounding was independently checked.
